Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/zlib && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')
trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"test/infcover.c","function":"cover_inflate","line":597,"var":"hex input","code":"try(\"c c0 81 0 0 0 0 0 90 ff 6b 4 0\", \"invalid distance too far back\", 1);","note":"This exact test case is already known to drive inflate() into the invalid-distance path."},
  {"step":2,"file":"test/infcover.c","function":"h2b","line":245,"var":"in","code":"in = malloc((strlen(hex) + 1) >> 1); ... decode hex pairs into bytes","note":"The hex string is converted into the raw compressed byte sequence used as attacker input."},
  {"step":3,"file":"test/infcover.c","function":"inf","line":293,"var":"strm.next_in / strm.avail_in","code":"mem_setup(&strm); ... strm.avail_in = step; strm.next_in = in;","note":"The decoded bytes are installed into the z_stream before decompression begins."},
  {"step":4,"file":"inflate.c","function":"inflate","line":0,"var":"state->mode","code":"inflate() parses the deflate stream and reaches the LEN decoding path where fast decoding may be used.","note":"Control reaches the code that interprets literal/length and distance symbols from the attacker-controlled stream."},
  {"step":5,"file":"inffast.c","function":"inflate_fast","line":120,"var":"len","code":"here = lcode[hold & lmask]; ... if (op & 16) { len = (unsigned)(here.val); ... }","note":"A length symbol is decoded, establishing a back-reference copy operation."},
  {"step":6,"file":"inffast.c","function":"inflate_fast","line":145,"var":"dist","code":"here = dcode[hold & dmask]; ... dist += (unsigned)hold & ((1U << op) - 1);","note":"A distance symbol is decoded that points farther back than the available output history."},
  {"step":7,"file":"inffast.c","function":"inflate_fast","line":173,"var":"state->sane / strm->msg","code":"if (op > whave) { if (state->sane) { strm->msg = \"invalid distance too far back\"; state->mode = BAD; break; } }","note":"The root cause is the invalid back-reference check; the decoder rejects the out-of-range distance instead of copying from invalid memory."}
]
p.write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace,separators=(',',':')))
print(p.read_text())
